I therefore emphasize matched local curves and loading contrasts, while adding distinct high-width families and two lower-width molecule-novel anchors for calibration.","batch_rationale":"The batch combines local condition-response and loading experiments for m117, m45, m119, m72, m80, m13, m125, m129, and related scaffolds with high-width tail transfer tests in m60, m51, m94, m128, m98, m166, m190, m67, m89, and m177. Several pairs are intentionally structured to distinguish solvent-strength effects from amount effects and to resolve whether V1 and V2 move together. The m68 and m116 molecule-novel anchors preserve coverage of ordinary retention behavior. This should improve Row-distribution generalization by teaching both the extreme conditional tails and the chemical regions where broad predictions are conservative."}
